title: Two-step copying of one bit
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $p$ be a valid input-head position, let the source word be $u b v$ for Boolean words $u,v$ and a bit $b$, and let $r$ be a record. After two steps of the copier from its reading control, with input-head position $p$, source-head position $|u|$, and record $r$, the configuration has the same input-head position and source word, source-head position $|u|+1$, and record $rbb$; it remains in the reading control.
hypotheses_covered: remaining source word beginning with bit $b$
replaced: For every input word, input position, source prefix $u$, remaining source bits starting with $b$, and record, two steps of the copier from its reading control at cell $|u|$ append the two bits $b, b$ to the record and advance the source head to cell $|u| + 1$; the source tape is unchanged.
